1.explanation: The TableToolbarSearch component is responsible for wrapping the Search component in the DataTable toolbar and for toggling CSS classes (via handleExpand) that drive the ‘active’ and ‘expandable’ states of the search container. Those classes (e.g. `${prefix}--toolbar-search-container-active`) determine the padding and positioning of the Search component when you hover. The Search class itself (and its render method) applies the base search styles and renders the magnifier icon inside its wrapper. Because the toolbar-specific container classes coming from TableToolbarSearch are composed onto Search’s own CSS, the layout rules in these two components are colliding and causing the misalignment. Fixing this will require adjusting either the class names or the CSS in TableToolbarSearch (or the Search render wrapper) so that the magnifier icon centers correctly in the toolbar context.
1.bug_scenario: When you hover over the DataTable “filter” search icon in the toolbar, the gray expandable container appears but the magnifier icon is offset—both vertically and horizontally—inside its shaded background. In the screenshots you can see that on hover the little search icon is not centered in its container and looks stuck too far down and to the left.

2.explanation: The TableToolbarSearch component is responsible for toggling the ‘expanded’ state and applying the toolbar-specific container classes (via the searchClasses variable) to the underlying Search component. The handleExpand method and the searchClasses className builder drive the CSS hooks that show or hide the gray background on hover/focus. Inside the Search component, the render method wraps the magnifier icon in a div with its own positioning (.cds--search-magnifier). The combination of the outer toolbar container classes and the inner Search markup/CSS causes the icon to remain in its original position rather than centering in the expanded background. Adjusting how searchClasses is applied (or tweaking the Search render layout) will realign the icon within its expanding container.
2.bug_scenario: When hovering or focusing on the DataTable toolbar’s filter/search icon (TableToolbarSearch) the search container expands (gray background) but the magnifier icon does not shift or re-center inside it. This results in the icon appearing offset to the right and misaligned inside its expanded container.
